messages:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners for alert tuning items from last incident (noise, thresholds, dedupe, paging). Short thread to assign and track.

Maya: Items: exporter night noise, prediction-service mem thresholds, dedupe cross-AZ DB errors, paging policy for low-impact alerts.

Aisha: I can own exporter noise. Plan: hourly noise histogram, add suppression window 23:00-06:00 UTC, and trim benign logs. Target: 2026-04-02.

Liam: I'll take thresholds for prediction-service. Steps: pull 14d samples, propose two threshold candidates, canary test, then roll. Target: 2026-03-31.

Rob: I'll prototype dedupe and draft paging policy. Dedupe idea: signature = sha1(service + error_class + short_stackhash), window=15m. Will include runbook entries for false-suppression. Target: 2026-04-06.

Maya: ops-bot create ticket and put acceptance metrics: nightly_pager_count, unique_alert_signatures, median_time_to_silence.

ops-bot: Created INFR-4620 and assigned Aisha/Liam/Rob with due dates.

Aisha: PromQL I'll run: sum by(hour)(increase(alerts_fired_total{alertname=~"Telemetry.*"}[7d])) - will attach CSV to INFR-4620.

Rob: draft paging snippet WIP:
```
suppress:
  hours: [23,0,1,2,3,4,5]
  severity: ["P2","P3"]
```
Will add rollback steps.

Liam: will add revert play in runbook if new thresholds spike FP rate.

Maya: OK. Recurring "Alert Quality" sync biweekly starting 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC. Add tickets to calendar. Thanks. :thumbsup:
